dimensions.name: token-completeness
dimensions.reason: role tokens cover neutral surfaces, text, accent, danger, spacing, typography, radius, border, elevation, icon, image and bounded motion

dimensions.name: component-anatomy
dimensions.reason: 16 visible or strongly implied components are mapped; core components include anatomy, variants, states, token ties, content/layout rules and accessibility

dimensions.name: state-completeness
dimensions.reason: observed selection, caret, active mode, toggle, modal, destructive, empty and rail-collapse states are defined; unsupported collaboration/error states are explicit

dimensions.name: composition-rules
dimensions.reason: Region topology, persistence, inspector scope, document width, library density modes, settings form and modal rules are implementation-ready

dimensions.name: responsive-semantics
dimensions.reason: desktop collapse priority is usable, but mobile/iPad relocation is intentionally UNKNOWN

dimensions.name: agent-rules
dimensions.reason: surface recipes, allowed/forbidden moves, critique checklist and review protocol prevent generic SaaS drift

dimensions.name: unsupported-semantics
dimensions.reason: dark, mobile, collaboration, offline/error and exact native values are named rather than guessed

dimensions.name: remaining-redesign-risk
dimensions.reason: Layoutcrafts can implement the desktop shell without redesigning topology; it must source new evidence for unsupported surfaces

non_blocking_ambiguity: Exact control heights and native point values require render calibration.
Dark and mobile variants require separate evidence and must not be inferred from this release.
